axis: a false belief dismissed as a light notion → a false idea condemned as hollow and unworkable

members.tone: The gentlest way to call a widely held belief false, treating the error as a passing notion rather than an indictment of anyone holding it.
Sharper than *fancy*: the false belief is cast as something wished into being, so holding it looks like self-indulgence rather than a slip.
Adds unworkability to falseness — the idea is not only illusory but could never be carried out, and the word keeps the burst inside it.
